# Add ABOVE the "PASSENGER" block that cPanel's Node.js selector generates in
# the app's .htaccess (do not edit inside the generated block).
RewriteEngine On

# Force HTTPS
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://alibabatraveladvisor.com/$1 [L,R=301]

# Canonical host: www -> non-www
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\.alibabatraveladvisor\.com$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://alibabatraveladvisor.com/$1 [L,R=301]

<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/css application/javascript application/json image/svg+xml
</IfModule>
